searchText: Can you describe what the advantage of b) is over the current mechanism? Is is that reverting finality at each step is 1/3 slashable to the point of that finality? This looks to me as both quite doable and smart Yes, the advantage is that you still get economic finality immediately and building up over time, rather than it coming all at once after 2 epochs.
